headline.two_regime_finding: undersaturated (fluid_dic=0.002, SI -15): sustained H2 flux, NO precipitation/throttling; supersaturated (fluid_dic=0.02, SI +3.2): throttling EXERCISED (precip 0.26, accessibility 1->0.88, porosity 0.35->0) but supply chokes (H2_flux ->8.5e-9). No single operating point sustains flux over BOTH transport and mineral-evolution timescales - the interface self-limits at precipitating conditions.
headline.supersaturating_feed_vs_posterior: fluid_dic 20 mM reaches SI+3.2; vent DIC posterior is 1.2-2.9 mM, so the supersaturating point is ~7-16x over the posterior DIC (Lost City does precipitate carbonate chimneys, so supersaturation is geochemically real at the precipitation front).
